#Bot API reference

The HTTP API that bots talk to. The official client libraries (@disband/bot and disband-bot) wrap the core and extended endpoints, so you can usually call them directly instead of hand-rolling HTTP. This page is the full contract and the recipe for writing a client in any language.

The extended management surface — private channels, categories, roles, audit, bans, server settings, and webhooks — is also documented in depth in Extended API and private channels. This page covers the whole contract, with the extended endpoints summarised.

#Base URL and authentication

https://www.disband.dev

Every request sends:

Header Value
Authorization Bot <token>
Content-Type application/json

A missing or invalid token returns 401 { "error": "Invalid bot token" }. A revoked bot returns the same, so a 401 means "check the token" — not "retry".

All endpoints are scoped: a bot can only read or write what its scopes (and the per-server grants) allow. Every 4xx/5xx response is JSON with an error field.

#Scopes

A bot's reach in a space is the intersection of:

  1. the scopes chosen on the bot account, and
  2. the scopes the space owner approved for that bot.

Lowering an account scope immediately trims it from existing space grants. Adding it back does not restore the old grant; the bot must be approved again.

The scope names are dotted:

Scope Description
messages.read Receive message events and read messages, channels, categories, and pins.
messages.write Send and edit messages, and pin messages.
messages.delete Delete and bulk-delete messages, and unpin messages.
messages.react Add and remove the bot's reactions.
members.read List members and read member/role details.
members.kick Kick members.
members.ban Ban, unban, and list bans.
members.timeout Time out members.
channels.read List channels and categories, read channel detail and overwrites.
channels.manage Create, update, reorder, and delete channels and categories; set overwrites.
webhooks.manage Create, edit, and delete webhooks.
roles.manage Create, edit, and delete roles; assign roles; set channel overwrites.
servers.read Read server metadata.
audit.read Read the audit log.

Management actions also need the matching role permission on the bot's account in that space, such as manage_channels, manage_roles, manage_messages, manage_webhooks, manage_server, or pin_messages.

#Read before writing

  • Bots are read-scoped unless you grant a write scope.
  • channels.manage actions also require the bot account to hold the manage_channels role in that server.
  • roles.manage actions also require manage_roles.
  • webhooks.manage actions also require manage_webhooks.
  • Nothing in the API returns data the bot was not granted. Lists omit what the bot cannot see instead of returning it with a flag.
  • Private channels are omitted from listings and their events are not delivered to bots without can_view. See private channels.

#The gateway (event long-poll)

GET /api/v1/gateway?timeout=20

The gateway is a long-poll, not a websocket. The request blocks server-side until an event is available or the timeout elapses, then returns what arrived. The client loops on it. Timeout is clamped to 1–20 seconds.

Response:

{
  "events": [
    {
      "id": 123,
      "type": "messageCreate",
      "payload": { "id": "…", "channel_id": "…", "server_id": "…", "content": "…" }
    }
  ]
}

#Event types

Type Payload Required scope
messageCreate Full message object messages.read on the bot and the space grant
messageUpdate id, channel_id, server_id, content, edited_at messages.read
messageDelete id, channel_id, server_id messages.read
memberJoin server_id, joined_at, user members.read on the space grant
memberLeave server_id, user_id members.read
memberUpdate server_id, user_id, roles members.read
interactionCreate Interaction object (below) Bot must be in the space

Delivery is at-least-once — a bot that crashes between fetch and handling may see the same event again. Handle them idempotently (by event or payload id). Only channels the bot can view produce message events.

#Message object

{
  "id": "…",
  "channel_id": "…",
  "server_id": "…",
  "author": { "id": "…", "username": "…", "display_name": "…", "avatar_url": "…", "is_bot": false },
  "content": "Deploy finished",
  "embeds": [],
  "components": [],
  "interaction": null,
  "webhook_id": null,
  "reply_to_id": null,
  "mentions": [],
  "attachment_url": null,
  "attachment_type": null,
  "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "edited_at": null,
  "display_id": 1234
}

#Interaction object

{
  "id": "…",
  "type": "command",
  "server_id": "…",
  "channel_id": "…",
  "user": { "id": "…", "username": "…", "display_name": "…", "avatar_url": "…" },
  "command": { "name": "weather", "options": { "city": "Berlin" } },
  "component": null,
  "created_at": "…",
  "expires_at": "…"
}

For a button press, type is component and component contains { "custom_id": "…", "message_id": "…" } instead of command.

#Endpoints

All paths below are relative to https://www.disband.dev.

#Messages

GET /api/v1/channels/:id/messages — reads messages (messages.read).

Query: limit (1–100, default 50), before (message UUID, for paging backwards).

Returns 200 with { "messages": [ … ] }, newest first.

POST /api/v1/channels/:id/messages — sends a message (messages.write).

{
  "content": "Deploy finished",
  "reply_to_id": null,
  "embeds": [],
  "components": []
}

content is required unless embeds is non-empty. Up to 10 embeds and up to 5 action rows of 5 buttons. Returns 201 with { "message": { … } }.

PATCH /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId — edits a message (messages.write or messages.delete).

{ "content": "Deploy finished (edited)", "embeds": [], "components": [] }

A bot can edit its own messages; editing someone else's needs manage_messages. Omitting a field leaves it unchanged; null clears embeds/components. Returns { "message": { … } }.

DELETE /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId — deletes a message (messages.delete).

A bot can always delete its own; deleting someone else's needs manage_messages. Returns 204.

POST /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/bulk-delete — deletes up to 100 messages (messages.delete).

{ "message_ids": ["uuid", "uuid"] }

UUIDs only. Returns { "deleted": 12 }.

messageId may be a UUID or the numeric display_id in the single-message routes. Bulk delete accepts UUIDs only.

#Reactions

PUT /api/v1/channels/:id/messages/:messageId/reactions/:emoji — adds the bot's reaction (messages.react).

{emoji} is URL-encoded and 1–32 characters. Returns { "reaction": { "id": "…", "message_id": "…", "emoji": "✅" } }.

DELETE the same path — removes the bot's reaction. Returns { "removed": true } or { "removed": false }. Idempotent.

When a channel uses overwrites, react follows can_react and the role's add_reactions permission.

#Pins

GET /api/v1/channels/:id/pins — lists pinned messages (messages.read).

Returns { "pins": [ … ] }, newest pin first, each with the full message when it still exists.

PUT /api/v1/channels/:id/pins/:messageId — pins a message (messages.write or messages.delete + pin_messages).

Returns { "pin": { "id": "…", "message_id": "…", "channel_id": "…" } }. Idempotent.

DELETE the same path — unpins. Returns { "removed": true } or { "removed": false }. Idempotent.

#Channels

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/channels — lists channels (messages.read, channels.read, or channels.manage).

Returns only channels the bot can view, ordered by position:

{
  "channels": [
    {
      "id": "…",
      "name": "general",
      "type": "text",
      "category_id": "…",
      "category_name": "Text Channels",
      "position": 0,
      "topic": "…",
      "slow_mode_seconds": 0,
      "read_only": false,
      "locked": false,
      "is_stage": false,
      "user_limit": null,
      "can_post": true,
      "can_react": true,
      "can_attach": true,
      "can_manage": false
    }
  ]
}

POST /api/v1/servers/:id/channels — creates a channel (channels.manage + manage_channels).

{
  "name": "deploys",
  "type": "text",
  "category_id": null,
  "topic": null,
  "slow_mode_seconds": 0,
  "read_only": false,
  "user_limit": null,
  "permissions": [
    { "role_id": "role-uuid", "can_view": false },
    { "role_id": "staff-role-uuid", "can_view": true, "can_post": true }
  ]
}

Returns 201 with { "channel_id": "…", "channel": { … } }. To make a private channel, deny can_view for @everyone and allow it for staff; see private channels.

GET /api/v1/channels/:id — channel detail (messages.read, channels.read, or channels.manage).

Returns { "channel": { … } }, including effective permissions and — when the bot has manage_channels — its role overwrites. A channel the bot cannot view returns 404.

PATCH /api/v1/channels/:id — updates a channel (channels.manage + manage_channels).

{ "name": "deploys-2", "topic": "…", "slow_mode_seconds": 10, "category_id": null, "position": 1, "read_only": false, "locked": false, "user_limit": null }

Returns { "channel": { … } }. Channels cannot change type.

DELETE /api/v1/channels/:id — deletes a channel and its messages (channels.manage + manage_channels). Returns 204.

#Channel permissions

GET /api/v1/channels/:id/permissions — lists the channel's role overwrites (channels.read, channels.manage, or roles.manage).

Returns { "permissions": [ { "role_id": "…", "can_view": false, "can_post": null, "can_react": null, "can_attach": null } ] }.

PUT /api/v1/channels/:id/permissions/:roleId — sets an overwrite (channels.manage or roles.manage, plus manage_channels).

{ "can_view": true, "can_post": true, "can_react": null, "can_attach": null }

true allows, false denies, null inherits. Returns { "ok": true }. The role must sit below the bot's highest role (@everyone excepted).

DELETE the same path — removes the override so the role inherits again. Returns { "ok": true }.

#Categories

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/categories — lists categories (messages.read, channels.read, or channels.manage).

Returns { "categories": [ { "id": "…", "name": "…", "position": 0, "channel_count": 2 } ] }. channel_count only counts channels the bot can view.

POST /api/v1/servers/:id/categories — creates a category (channels.manage + manage_channels).

{ "name": "Support" }

Returns 201 with { "category": { … } }.

PATCH /api/v1/categories/:id — renames or reorders (channels.manage + manage_channels).

{ "name": "Support", "position": 2 }

Returns { "category": { … } }.

DELETE /api/v1/categories/:id — deletes a category. Its channels become uncategorized. Returns 204.

There are no category-level permissions; channel overwrites are authoritative.

#Servers

GET /api/v1/servers/:id — server metadata and member count (servers.read, messages.read, channels.read, channels.manage, or members.read).

Returns { "server": { "id": "…", "name": "…", "description": "…", "icon_url": "…", "banner_url": "…", "owner_id": "…", "created_at": "…", "discoverable": true, "verified": false, "member_count": 42 } }.

PATCH /api/v1/servers/:id — updates server settings (manage_server).

{ "name": "New name", "description": "…", "discoverable": true }

Returns { "server": { … } }.

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/permissions — the bot's scopes, roles, highest role position, and role-permission map in this space. Useful for feature detection before attempting a management action.

#Members

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/members — lists members (members.read).

Returns { "members": [ … ] }, sorted by display name.

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/members/:userId — member detail (members.read). Returns { "member": { … } } with roles and any active timeout.

DELETE /api/v1/servers/:id/members/:userId — kicks a member (members.kick). Returns { "ok": true }.

PATCH /api/v1/servers/:id/members/:userId — times a member out (members.timeout).

{ "timeout_minutes": 10, "reason": "Cooling off" }

1–40,320 minutes. Returns { "ok": true, "timed_out_until": "…" }.

PUT /api/v1/servers/:id/members/:userId/roles/:roleId — gives a role (roles.manage + manage_roles).

DELETE the same path — takes the role away. Both return { "ok": true }.

Role and moderation actions protect the owner, moderators, other bots, and the bot itself. Roles must sit below the bot's highest role.

#Bans

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/bans — lists bans, newest first (members.ban or the ban role permission).

Returns { "bans": [ { "user_id": "…", "banned_by": "…", "reason": "…", "created_at": "…" } ] }.

PUT /api/v1/servers/:id/bans/:userId — bans a user (members.ban).

{ "reason": "Spam" }

Returns { "ok": true }.

DELETE the same path — unbans (members.ban + ban). Returns { "removed": true } or { "removed": false }.

#Roles

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/roles — lists roles, highest first (roles.manage or members.read).

Returns { "roles": [ … ] }, each with display_id, permissions, is_default, self_assignable, and manageable.

POST /api/v1/servers/:id/roles — creates a role (roles.manage + manage_roles).

{ "name": "Ticket Staff", "color": "#5865f2", "permissions": { "send_messages": true }, "self_assignable": false, "position": 2 }

Returns 201 with { "role": { … } }. A space can have 250 roles.

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/roles/:roleId — one role (roles.manage or members.read).

PATCH /api/v1/servers/:id/roles/:roleId — edits a role (roles.manage + manage_roles). Omitted fields stay unchanged. @everyone cannot be edited.

DELETE /api/v1/servers/:id/roles/:roleId — deletes a role (roles.manage + manage_roles). Returns { "ok": true }.

roleId may be a UUID or numeric display_id.

Permission keys: add_reactions, attach_files, ban, create_invites, kick, manage_channels, manage_emojis, manage_messages, manage_roles, manage_server, manage_webhooks, mention_everyone, pin_messages, send_messages, timeout_members, view_audit_log.

#Audit log

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/audit?limit=100 — reads the audit log (audit.read or the view_audit_log role permission).

Returns { "audit": [ { "id": "…", "actor_id": "…", "action": "channel.create", "target_type": "channel", "target_id": "…", "details": { … }, "created_at": "…" } ] }, newest first. limit is 1–100.

#Webhooks

GET /api/v1/servers/:id/webhooks — lists webhooks, newest first (webhooks.manage + manage_webhooks).

Returns { "webhooks": [ … ] }, each including its secret posting url. Webhooks in channels the bot cannot view are omitted, and fetching, moving, rotating, or deleting one of them returns 404.

POST /api/v1/servers/:id/webhooks — creates a webhook (webhooks.manage + manage_webhooks).

{ "channel_id": "…", "name": "Deploys", "avatar_url": null }

Returns 201 with { "webhook": { … } }.

GET /api/v1/webhooks/:webhookId — one webhook. PATCH updates name, avatar_url, channel_id, or rotates the token with { "reset_token": true }. DELETE soft-deletes it and returns 204.

Limits: 50 webhooks per space, 15 per channel. Treat webhook URLs as secrets.

#Slash commands

GET /api/v1/commands — lists the bot's commands.

POST /api/v1/commands — creates or updates one command by name.

{
  "name": "weather",
  "description": "Show the forecast",
  "options": [
    { "name": "city", "description": "City name", "type": "string", "required": true }
  ]
}

PUT /api/v1/commands — replaces the whole command list.

DELETE /api/v1/commands?name=weather — removes one command.

Names are 1–32 lowercase letters, digits, _, or -. Descriptions are 1–100 characters. Up to 25 options and 100 commands per bot. Option types: string, integer, number, boolean, user, channel, role.

#Interactions

POST /api/v1/interactions/:interactionId/callback — answers a slash command or button press within 15 minutes.

{ "content": "Here is the forecast", "ephemeral": true }
  • update: true edits the message a button is on instead of posting a reply.
  • ephemeral: true (or flags: 64) shows the reply only to the invoker.
  • Up to 5 answers per interaction.
  • No messages.write scope is needed; the member asked the bot directly.

#Leaving

POST /api/v1/servers/:id/leave — removes the bot from a server.

Returns { "success": true }.

#Invites

POST /api/v1/bots/:botId/invites — generates an invite for the bot to join a server.

{ "server_id": "…", "scopes": ["messages.read", "messages.write"] }

The token must belong to that bot, the requested scopes must be a subset of the bot's account scopes, and the caller must be a member of the target space. Returns the invite code and invite_url. Targeted invites expire after 7 days.

General install links are created by the bot owner from the developers portal (or POST /api/bot/install-link) and let the recipient pick a space they manage.

#Bot management (owner only)

POST /api/bot/update — update a bot's name, avatar, banner, bio, or scopes.

{ "botId": "…", "name": "New Name", "avatarUrl": "https://…", "bannerUrl": "https://…", "bio": "…", "scopes": ["messages.read", "messages.write"] }

All fields except botId are optional. Returns { "ok": true }.

POST /api/bot/register — create a new bot.

{ "name": "My Bot", "scopes": ["messages.read", "messages.write"] }

Returns { "bot": { … }, "token": "…" }. The token is shown once.

POST /api/bot/revoke — revoke a bot's token.

{ "botId": "…" }

Returns { "ok": true }. Revocation is immediate and irreversible.

POST /api/bot/reset-token — rotate a bot's token. The old token stops working immediately; the new token is shown once.

#Identity (used at startup)

GET /api/bot/me — returns the bot account, used by the clients to fire ready. Not part of the versioned v1 surface.

#Errors

Status Meaning error field examples
400 Missing/invalid input, unknown field, or limit exceeded. "Channel name is required"
401 Missing/invalid/revoked token. "Invalid bot token"
403 Missing scope or role permission, hierarchy violation, read-only. "This bot does not have messages.write in that server"
404 Channel/server/message/member/role not found or not visible. "Channel not found"
429 Rate limited. Includes a Retry-After header.
503 Backing store unavailable (gateway polling). "Event delivery unavailable."
5xx Server error. Retry with backoff. "Internal space error"

Some hidden resources return 403 instead of 404 (for example, reading messages in a channel the bot cannot view). Treat both as "not available".

#Limits

  • Up to 5 bots per account; a bot's token dies instantly on revoke.
  • Messages up to 4,000 characters; @everyone needs the mention_everyone role permission.
  • Up to 10 embeds and 5 action rows of 5 buttons per message.
  • Up to 100 permission overwrites per channel, 250 roles per space, 100 commands per bot, and 50 webhooks per space (15 per channel).
  • Rate limits apply per bot token:
    • gateway long-poll: 15/min
    • reads: 120/min
    • writes: 60/min
    • invites: 10/min
    • registration: 10/day per owner
  • If you hit 429, honor Retry-After.

#Writing your own client

  1. GET /api/bot/me with Authorization: Bot <token> to resolve identity.
  2. Loop on GET /api/v1/gateway?timeout=20, handle events by type.
  3. Use the endpoints above with the same auth header; map 401 → "bad token", 403 → "missing permission", 404 → "gone or invisible", 429 → "slow down and retry after Retry-After".
  4. Before management actions, call GET /api/v1/servers/:id/permissions and check the role-permission map instead of guessing.

The official clients are @disband/bot (JavaScript) and disband-bot (Python) — see the JavaScript and Python pages. They wrap the endpoints on this page, including the extended management surface. For private channels, tickets, categories, audit, bans, and webhooks, see the Extended API for recipes and details.
